messages:
Kai (CS): Starting the HarborLane onboarding thread. Lina (PM) flagged a 4-week pilot to validate support autopilot: quick reply suggestions, KB-retrieval accuracy, and measurable handle time reduction. Renewal decision is in ~55 days so let's capture solid metrics. Who can own integration, SLOs, and enablement?

Lina (HarborLane): Hi all 12; we're aiming for a pilot start in 10 business days. Top-line success metrics: 30% reduction in AHT for targeted flows, precision@5 for embeddings >0.72, p95 response <200ms. We'll share a sanitized KB export and 2 days of chat logs.

Renee (Solutions): I can lead integration + prompt templates. My delivery plan:
- Day0-2: access + schema mapping
- Day3-7: prototype endpoint + UI hook
- Day8-12: retrieval tuning + evals
- Week4: pilot readout
Need to know if they prefer API keys or mTLS. Also, token estimate depends on sampling fraction of transcripts.

Omar (Eng): I'll cover runtime, caching, and rollout policy. Suggest using hosted for prototype, with a private fallback in case of compliance. For canary, I recommend 24-48h with traffic ramp to 10%. Please provide expected concurrent agents and average session length.

Marta (Enablement): I'll create a 60m live workshop + a one-pager runbook and a quick triage flow. Requesting two shadow reps during canary and a list of top-20 ticket templates to tailor examples.

Lina (HarborLane): Concurrent agents average 6, peak 18. Avg session length ~3-7min. We'll deliver KB and top templates by EOD tomorrow. No PII in initial sample. Procurement may request an ROI memo mid-pilot.

Kai (CS): Risks to call out: renewal timeline (~55d) and embedding index cost if we ingest full KB. We'll prioritize metrics mapping to renewal (AHT reduction and embed precision). Also flag if Private deployment is needed; that can add +2 weeks.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "HarborLane Onboard Kickoff" in 36h with Lina, Kai, Renee, Omar, Marta.

Renee (Solutions): Cost thumb: prototype sampling ~40k tokens/week; full pilot with heavy retrieval ~180-220k tokens/week. I'll prepare a sampling plan to keep costs predictable.

Omar (Eng): Action items for Lina: share KB format, avg doc length, and whether embeddings should be refreshed daily. Also confirm retention/security requirements.

Lina (HarborLane): I'll send KB export + doc stats by tomorrow morning. Daily embedding refresh is fine for pilot. Retention: standard SLA, no special hold.

Kai (CS): Final quick summary to pin below:
```
Owners & Deadlines:
- Renee: integration + UI prototype (due Day7)
- Omar: runtime sizing + canary plan (due Day10)
- Marta: enablement materials + workshop (due Day14)
- Lina: KB export + templates (due Day1)
- Kai: pilot dashboard & renewal-aligned metrics (due Day3)
Risks: procurement check at ~Day55; Private deployment adds ~2w delay; embedding storage cost if full KB used.
Success criteria (HarborLane): 30% AHT reduction, precision@5 >0.72, p95 <=200ms
```
I'll post a short one-pager and create a tracker doc after kickoff. If anyone needs to swap owners, DM me. :white_check_mark:
